server.name: internal-quotes-mcp
server.description: Internal Enterprise Quote Repository & Deal Desk MCP Server running on Cloud Run (brianreevz.altostrat.com).

tools.name: match_eligible_quotes
tools.description: Read-only tool for the 2-Legged Sentinel Agent to identify open customer quotes containing a discounted vendor SKU (e.g. 'SKU-NET-MERAKI-MR36') and enqueue an Account Executive handoff alert.

tools.name: list_my_active_quotes
tools.description: Read-only tool for the 3-Legged Deal Desk Copilot to list open quotes strictly owned by the authenticated human user (e.g. 'brian@brianreevz.altostrat.com').

annotations.title: List My Active Quotes (3-Legged RBAC Filtered)

tools.name: reprice_quote
tools.description: Privileged write tool requiring 3-Legged user delegation to reprice an existing quote (e.g. Quote #1042) with a vendor promotion and target margin percentage. Blocked (403 Forbidden) for 2-Legged Sentinel Agents and cross-tenant users.

quote_id.description: Quote ID to update (e.g. 1042 for Brian's Acme Corp quote, or 9999 for Dave's Cyberdyne quote).

promo_wholesale_cost.description: Promotional unit wholesale cost in USD (e.g. 360.0).

user_email.description: Authenticated 3-legged user identity performing the update (e.g. 'brian@brianreevz.altostrat.com').

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode ('3_legged_oauth' for Copilot user delegation or '2_legged_agent_identity' for M2M Sentinel).
